survey: A shallow round glass plate sits flat on a wooden table, seen from slightly above and in front, with its rim showing as an even ellipse. A watermelon wedge stands upright at the back, held up by the fruit in front of it. Its green rind runs along the curved right edge, its red flesh faces the camera, and its seeds are spread evenly. A bunch of green grapes sits on the left, with a woody stem and one leaf joined at the top of the bunch. Two strawberries sit in the middle, each with a green calyx on top. Four blueberries sit in front on the plate, each with a crown at its blossom end. Two orange wedges lean together on the right: the cut faces show segments spreading out from the center, and a thin peel runs along the outer arc. Every piece of fruit rests on the plate or on another piece of fruit. Nothing floats, and nothing passes through anything else.
